newsitem.title: UK: Kray case detective to head British boxing board.
newsitem.headline: Kray case detective to head British boxing board.

text.p: The detective who put infamous London gangsters Reggie and Ronnie Kray behind bars in the 1960s has been named chairman of the British Boxing Board of Control, the sport's ruling body in Britain.

Leonard "Nipper" Read has been deputy chairman of the board for eight years and is stepping up to replace Sir David Hopkin, who retains the executive position of president, the board said in a statement on Tuesday. Read, a former police boxing champion, has worked for the board since the 1970s.
